audit_rule: Re-audit upstream source/docs before promoting any candidate. A feature already supported as a normal engine knob is not a headline M7 optimization by itself.

candidates.title: Adaptive mixed prefill/decode token budget
candidates.why_not_parameter_only: The candidate changes the effective scheduling budget per engine step using live mixed-batch state instead of choosing one static engine argument.
notes: Reference implementation is code-ready but not selected.
Do not claim benefit before the M7 selection gate passes.

candidates.title: Priority scheduling with wait-time aging
candidates.why_not_parameter_only: Would dynamically change effective priority with waiting time to bound starvation rather than only enabling the existing static priority policy.
notes: No runtime implementation is committed until starvation is observed and the source audit confirms a real gap.

candidates.title: Static KV watermark tuning
notes: Useful baseline/control, but not a main M7 contribution.

candidates.title: Static queued-token admission cap
notes: Useful QoS baseline/control, not a new optimization.

candidates.title: Static scheduler token-budget sweep
evidence_needed: same workload across several static budgets
notes: Required control for any adaptive-budget claim.

candidates.title: Topology-aware tensor-parallel placement
candidates.why_not_parameter_only: Can be a deployment/system optimization if M5 evidence shows topology-sensitive communication behavior, but it is not automatically the headline M7 algorithm.
evidence_needed: M5 same-NUMA vs cross-NUMA serving runs
notes: Retain as a system-level candidate if communication is the measured bottleneck.
